title: Signal: SQL built by concatenation in a rawQuery call in kotlin — review required
scope: Single-line match on a concatenated rawQuery in kotlin.
limitations: Lexical: matches rawQuery calls whose arguments contain a + concatenation on one line; interpolation through helper functions is out of scope.

examples.line: db.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + userId, null)
# audit: db.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + userId, null) present
db.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", arrayOf(userId))
# verified: db.rawQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", arrayOf(userId))

fpNotes: Statements assembled from compile-time constants are the accepted false positives.
